_comment: Tiny smoke fixture for the retrieval eval harness (SPIKE). All content is invented and generic — no real names, clients, or secrets. See docs/eval-harness.md.

memories.content: The staging database for acme-corp runs on port 5544.
The production database for acme-corp runs on port 5432.
Deploy cadence is weekly, every Thursday at 14:00 UTC.
The acme-corp public API base URL is https://api.example.test/v2.
The CDN cache TTL for static assets is 86400 seconds (one day).
On 2026-05-03 the payments service had a 22-minute outage caused by an expired TLS certificate. Mitigation was certificate renewal plus an auto-renew cron.
Migrated the metadata store from Postgres 14 to Postgres 16 over the weekend; pgvector extension reinstalled and indexes rebuilt.
Shipped the onboarding-widget feature behind a flag for beta accounts; rollout to all accounts planned for next sprint.
Decided to use RabbitMQ over Kafka for the job queue because the team already operates RabbitMQ and throughput needs are modest.

memories.subject: billing-service
memories.content: billing-service is healthy; p95 latency 180ms, error rate under 0.1%.
